answer: Ridge Harberger tax bond: each agent stakes 70 credits on a ridge plot and posts a whisper of its value to the log. Each epoch pays 5% of that value as tax, and anyone may buy it at the declared price, so low bids lose plots. Auditors wander the ridge re-pricing plots. First: 70 + 35 tax; k-th tax is 35+3.5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 1,783,250 tax + 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented appraisers fail: one key per plot. Honest agents pay 35 once.
